## Scientific and publication review (when applicable)
- [ ] No new scientific claims or changes in interpretation, or claims have primary sources, limitations, and a human source review
- [ ] No implication of collaborator endorsement/permission without authorization
- [ ] Proposed experiments remain clearly distinguished from completed findings
- [ ] Public-facing content/attribution approved by the repository owner
- [ ] No private data, tracking, or unpublished materials added
